title: Fixed Open Jug and Motor Base Blender
description: One original complete static countertop jug-blender appearance. Four short grounded feet carry a chamfered motor-base housing with a blank front dial. A short collar supports a newly authored tapered chamfered thick-walled jug with a genuine deep open cavity, solid floor and continuous forward pouring lip. A whole open rectangular side handle meets its upper and lower wall. A small fixed hub and four blunt thick paddles lie at the jug floor. Three opaque untextured PBR materials; the jug is intentionally opaque, not glass. Entire geometry newly authored, not the serving pitcher transplanted or a dough-mixer bowl resized. One prop and zero scenes. Fixed open-top display only; no lid, cable, internal motor or circuitry, food, liquid, motion, blending instructions, powered function, capacity, hygiene or safety claim. Hidden lower paddles are not claimed visible from every camera.
